Put the following exact text on the flyer with clear hierarchy: large title 'PICNIC IN THE PARK'; subtitle 'Good food. Fresh air. Great company.'; centered information block 'DATE: __________' then 'TIME: __________' then 'LOCATION: __________'; bottom callout 'Bring a blanket & your favorite snacks!'
